definitions.explanation: A family unit living together or related by blood.
All members of a family together.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}{全員|ぜんいん}で{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: The whole family went on a trip.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}の{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}です。
examples.english: He is the breadwinner of the family.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}に{一台|いちだい}は{必要|ひつよう}だ。

notes:
{一家|いっか} refers to a family or household unit.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一家|いっか}{全員|ぜんいん} (the whole family)
- {一家|いっか}に{一台|いちだい} (one per household)
- {一家|いっか}の{主|あるじ}/{大黒柱|だいこくばしら} (head of household/breadwinner)

RELATED WORDS:
- {家族|かぞく}: family (general term)
- {一家|いっか}: family/household (as a unit)
- {世帯|せたい}: household (administrative term)
